pe_assessment: Snapshot trailing/forward P/E 22.34/13.16 appears modest, but funding intensity makes earnings alone incomplete.
margin_analysis: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 30%; GAAP operating margin 35% versus 29%, while adjusted margin stayed 42%. Interest rose 55%.
debt_analysis: Debt $125.337bn less cash/securities gives $88.260bn net debt. CFO $23.103bn included $11.363bn financing prepayments; gross capex $28.499bn and $19.909bn equity proceeds reveal external funding dependence.
growth_outlook: IaaS grew 121% and RPO reached $664bn; revenue recognition and cash returns must catch up with contracted investment.
key_risks: Negative FCF and dependence on funding
summary: Cloud growth is substantial, but the current funding gap, leverage and dilution outweigh the low forward multiple in this assessment. Sell reflects financing risk rather than a claim of imminent insolvency.
